input: fresh licensed CRSP CIZ daily extraction, 2010-2025 warmup/history; French five daily factors, current historical vintage
universe: previous calendar-month final trading session; US-incorporated EQTY/COM/NS ordinary ACOR/CORP shares; regular-way active listings on N/A/Q; largest share class by PERMCO then largest 500 securities
return_duration: D1/D2/D3/D4/DU describe one trading period; P* and unknown-duration DD are retained in raw history but not relabeled as single-period outcomes
clock: observe t close; assume input available before t+1 09:00 NY; decide t+1; implement t+1 close; return ends t+2 close; label assumed available t+3 09:00 NY
factor_boundary: 252-session excess-return regression ending t-1; coefficients fixed at origin for t+2 residual target; current-vintage factors are ex-post attribution, not historical release-vintage proof
risk_scale: 252 past realized one-step risk residuals, ending t-1; no future target volatility
weight_normalization: training inverse variance clipped then mean-normalized; same fitted cap applies to evaluation
sensitivity: same outer folds on standardized target with equal observation weights
inference: date-level means; circular moving-block bootstrap, blocks 20 and 63 sessions, 2000 draws, seed 20261026
event_family: price shock abs(return_5)/[volatility_20*sqrt(5)]>=2 on observation date; offsets -5..5; positive/negative shocks; event-date clustering, overlapping windows disclosed
multiplicity: fixed eight-feature next-return RankIC family; date-dependent p-values, Bonferroni and BH at 0.05; unavailable hypotheses retained
basket: daily equal-weight top and bottom prediction quintiles; gross exposure 2, cost on sum absolute weight changes; raw, residual and slope diagnostics separate
rights: raw vendor records and per-security outputs private; no real-data aggregate publication before applicable rights review
